title: Wesco data center sales grow 45% in Q2 as its own AI investments proceed
description:
Distributor Wesco International announced record quarterly earnings results for its fiscal Q2 ended June 30, citing swelling demand from its artificial intelligence (AI) data center customers. Altogether, Wesco recorded $6.7 billion in net sales, up 13% from a year earlier. title: From AI Users to AI Builders: The Next Phase of AI in Marketing [MAICON 2026]
description: Most marketing teams have gotten comfortable using AI. They've integrated it into content workflows, sharpened their prompts, and found individual productivity gains.
